findings.obligation: S4 slice Observation: no rule holds back .NET
findings.remediation: Severity low, non-blocking. caps filters only on allowedVersions !== undefined. A .NET rule that holds back via enabled:false or ignoreDeps passes both tests. Current renovate.json has no such rule, so this is a coverage gap, not a defect. Either widen the predicate to enabled===false and ignoreDeps, or narrow the observation and test name to allowedVersions caps (the wording the test uses).

findings.obligation: S4 falsifier: a cap moved to a package name the matcher does not recognise as .NET
findings.remediation: Severity low, non-blocking, known gap. The allowlist covers the hold's former names only. A .NET-versioned package outside it (for example Microsoft.Extensions.* ) capped below 11 passes. Accept as a declared limit in the falsifier row, or extend the allowlist with a test that pins the list to the .NET packages the repo uses.
